fullDescription: Stacked, trust-forward social-proof page in a single deep-teal-on-white palette: a centered heading with a 'Trusted in production' badge over a masked six-logo logo wall, a three-up hairline-divided metric trust strip (120k+ designs, 4.9/5 rating, 9x faster) with tabular-nums teal numbers and hover top-bars, and a featured-quote card (oversized serif quote mark, five-star 'Featured story' chip, big pull-quote, gradient monogram byline + brand lockup) over a faint teal grid and soft teal glow, closing on a 'Verified customer story' seal line. Inter + Georgia quote mark, Phosphor via Iconify.

structured.summary: A stacked, trust-forward social-proof page in a deep-teal-on-white palette for a prompt-to-UI design product. Under a sticky blurred nav, three proof layers stack top-down: (1) a centered heading block (a rounded teal trust badge 'Trusted in production', an extrabold Inter headline 'The design layer behind teams that ship fast.', a muted subhead) above a six-logo logo wall set in a rounded paper panel whose edges fade via a horizontal mask; (2) a three-up metric trust strip in a single hairline-divided white card (120k+ designs generated, 4.9/5 average creator rating, 9x faster idea to UI), each cell with a big teal tabular-nums number, a label, and a sublabel, plus a teal gradient top-bar that fades in on hover; (3) a featured-quote block over a faint teal grid + a soft teal blur glob: a centered rounded card (teal gradient top hairline, an oversized serif quote mark, a five-star + 'Featured story' chip, a big bold pull-quote, and a byline with a teal gradient monogram avatar + name/role + a small brand lockup), with a 'Verified customer story' seal-check line beneath. Inter throughout, Georgia for the decorative quote mark, Phosphor icons via Iconify.

style.description: A calm, premium SaaS social-proof style built on a single deep-teal accent over near-white paper. The page ground is a very light slate paper (#f8fafc) with white panels; teal (#0f766e) is the only accent, reinforced by a deeper teal (#115e59), a brighter mid-teal (#14b8a6) for plus/slash/times glyphs and gradients, and a soft teal tint (#ccfbf1) for badge/glow fills. Type is all Inter with tight tracking: an extrabold (800/900) headline, semibold (600) labels, and a slate ink scale for hierarchy (near-black ink #0f172a headings, slate #475569 body, muted slate #64748b sublabels). Surfaces are crisp white rounded-2xl/3xl panels with hairline slate-200/70 borders and barely-there shadows; the featured quote card adds a soft long teal-tinted drop shadow and a teal gradient top hairline. Numbers use tabular-nums so the metric strip stays aligned. The decorative quotation mark is an oversized Georgia serif glyph at very low teal opacity for an editorial touch. Subtle motion: a teal gradient top-bar fades in on each metric cell hover, the nav CTA arrow nudges right, logos darken from slate to ink on hover. Mood: trustworthy, enterprise-credible, clean, modern; never flat, never garish.
style.prompt: Design a calm, premium SaaS social-proof / testimonial page in a single deep-teal accent over near-white paper, using Inter for all UI text (weights 400/500/600/700/800/900; tight tracking; headline extrabold/black 800-900) and Georgia serif only for one oversized decorative quotation mark. Palette: paper background #f8fafc, white panels #ffffff; ink/slate scale ink #0f172a, slate-700 #475569, slate-500 #64748b, hairline borders rgba(15,23,42,.06) and slate-200/70; teal scale teal #0f766e (DEFAULT accent), teal-deep #115e59 (hover/labels), teal-mid #14b8a6 (plus/slash/times glyphs + gradients), teal-soft #ccfbf1 (badge + glow tints). Use teal as the only hue. Surfaces: crisp white rounded-2xl/3xl panels with 1px slate-200/70 borders and near-flat shadows; a 'ring-hair' utility = box-shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04), 0 0 0 1px rgba(15,23,42,.06). The metric numbers are extrabold teal with tabular-nums (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; 'tnum' 1) so columns align; the +, /5 and x suffixes are teal-mid. Each metric cell has an absolute top-0 3px gradient bar (from teal to teal-mid) that is opacity-0 and fades to opacity-100 on group hover. The featured quote card is a rounded-3xl figure on a white->paper vertical gradient with a 1px teal/15 border, a teal->teal-mid->teal 1px top hairline, and a soft long drop shadow 0 24px 70px -30px rgba(15,118,110,0.35). Behind it: a faint teal grid (linear-gradient hairlines at rgba(15,118,110,.05), 44px tile) at ~60% opacity and a 72x72 teal-soft/60 blur-3xl glob bleeding off the left edge. The decorative quote mark is a 120px Georgia glyph in teal at ~12% opacity. Accent everything teal only: the 'Trusted in production' badge (teal-soft/50 fill, teal/20 border, teal-deep uppercase wide-tracked label + ph:shield-check-fill), the nav logo tile + 'Start free' pill (teal, hover teal-deep), five ph:star-fill stars, the gradient monogram avatar, the ph:seal-check-fill verified line. Icons via Iconify Phosphor (ph:*). Subtle motion only: metric hover top-bar fade, CTA arrow nudge, logo slate->ink hover. Keep it trustworthy, enterprise-credible and clean, never flat or garish.

layout_and_structure.description: A single-column, stacked social-proof page under a sticky nav, every band capped at max-w-6xl (the featured-quote band at max-w-4xl) with px-6 gutters and generous vertical padding. Top-down: (1) a sticky blurred paper header (h-16) with a logo lockup, center nav links, and sign-in + 'Start free' pill; (2) a white hero band (border-bottom hairline, a thin teal-fade top line) holding a centered heading block then a logo wall; (3) a paper band with a three-up metric trust strip in one hairline-divided white card; (4) a white featured-quote band layered over a faint teal grid + a soft teal blur glob, holding one centered quote card and a 'Verified customer story' seal line. Responsive: the nav center links hide below md and the sign-in link below sm; the headline goes 34px -> 44px from sm with an sm-only line break; the logo wall grid reflows 2 -> 3 -> 6 columns; the metric strip goes 1-col with horizontal divider lines to 3-col with vertical dividers from sm; the quote card padding and quote size step up from sm; the brand lockup in the byline hides below sm. No horizontal overflow at any width despite the masked logo wall, the faint grid, and the absolute glow layers.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (z-50) with a translucent paper background (paper/85 #f8fafc) + backdrop-blur-md and a 1px slate-200/70 bottom border. Inside a max-w-6xl row, h-16, items justify-between, px-6: left = a logo lockup = a rounded-lg teal tile (h-8 w-8, place-items-center, soft shadow) holding a white ph:sparkle-fill icon (18px), beside an extrabold tracking-tight 'Lumen' wordmark (17px); center = medium slate-700 nav links 'Product', 'Library', a currently-active ink 'Customers', 'Pricing' (gap-8, 14px), hidden below md and darkening to ink on hover; right = a semibold slate-700 'Sign in' ghost link (hidden below sm) and a solid teal rounded-full 'Start free' pill (px-[18px] py-2, 13.5px, white text, soft teal/25 shadow, hover teal-deep) with a ph:arrow-right-bold icon that nudges right (translate-x-0.5) on group hover.

A centered heading block capped at max-w-2xl, on a white band with a thin teal-fade top line and a hairline bottom border, pt-20/sm:pt-24 pb-16. (1) A trust badge: an inline-flex rounded-full chip with a teal-soft/50 fill, a teal/20 border, px-3.5 py-1.5, holding a ph:shield-check-fill icon (15px) and an uppercase wide-tracked (tracking-wider) teal-deep label 'Trusted in production' (12.5px, semibold). (2) An extrabold Inter headline (mt-6, text-[34px] -> sm:text-[44px], leading 1.08, tight tracking, ink, text-balance) reading 'The design layer behind teams that ship fast.' with an sm-only
before 'teams that ship fast.'. (3) A muted subhead paragraph (mt-4, max-w-lg, 15.5px, leading-relaxed, slate-700): 'From solo builders to product teams at scale, Lumen turns a prompt into shippable UI. Here is the proof.'

A logo wall below the heading (mt-14). A centered uppercase wide-tracked (0.18em) slate-500 caption 'Powering design at fast-moving teams' (11.5px, semibold). Below (mt-7) a rounded-2xl paper/60 panel with a 1px slate-200/70 border, px-6 py-7, whose left/right edges fade out via a horizontal mask-image (linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 6%, #000 94%, transparent)). Inside: a grid of six brand lockups (grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-3 -> lg:grid-cols-6, items-center, gap-x-6 gap-y-8), each a centered flex of a Phosphor glyph + a tracking-tight wordmark in slate-700 that darkens to ink on hover: ph:triangle-fill 'Vertex' (bold), ph:hexagon-fill 'Northpod' (bold), ph:circles-three-fill 'orbital' (extrabold lowercase), ph:cube-fill 'Stacklane' (semibold), ph:lightning-fill 'Flux' (bold italic), ph:diamond-fill 'Cadence' (bold), all ~18px.

A three-up metric trust strip on a paper band (py-14), in a single white card: grid-cols-1 with horizontal slate-200/80 dividers (divide-y) -> sm:grid-cols-3 with vertical dividers (sm:divide-x sm:divide-y-0), overflow-hidden rounded-2xl, 1px slate-200/80 border, ring-hair shadow. Each of the three cells is a group, relative, p-8/sm:p-10, text-center, and carries an absolute top-0 inset-x-0 3px gradient bar (from teal to teal-mid) that is opacity-0 and fades to opacity-100 on group hover. Cell content: a 46px extrabold leading-none tracking-tight teal number with tabular-nums, then a 14px semibold ink label, then a 12.5px slate-500 sublabel. Three cells: '120k+' (the + in teal-mid) / 'Designs generated' / 'across the canvas every month'; '4.9/5' (the /5 a smaller 26px align-top teal-mid) / 'Average creator rating' / 'from 2,300+ reviews'; '9x' (the x in teal-mid) / 'Faster idea to UI' / 'vs. a blank Figma file'.

A featured-quote band on white (max-w-4xl, py-24) layered over a faint teal grid (44px tile, rgba(15,118,110,.05) hairlines) at opacity-60 and a soft -left-24 top-1/2 72x72 teal-soft/60 blur-3xl glob. Centered in it, a rounded-3xl figure (max-w-3xl) on a white->paper vertical gradient with a 1px teal/15 border, px-10/sm:px-16 pt-14/sm:pt-16 pb-12/sm:pb-14, text-center, a long teal-tinted drop shadow (0 24px 70px -30px rgba(15,118,110,0.35)), and a teal->teal-mid->teal 1px top hairline. An oversized 120px Georgia serif opening-quote glyph in teal/12 sits absolute top-left. Stacked: (1) a rounded-full teal-soft/50 chip holding five ph:star-fill teal stars + an uppercase wide-tracked teal-deep 'Featured story' label; (2) a big bold pull-quote (mt-7, text-[26px] -> sm:text-[31px], leading 1.36, tracking-tight, ink, text-balance): 'Lumen collapsed our design backlog. We prompt a screen, get production-ready UI in seconds, and ship the same day. It is the most leverage our small team has ever had.'; (3) a byline (mt-10, flex items-center justify-center gap-4): a 12x12 rounded-full teal->teal-deep gradient monogram avatar 'MS' (white, ring-2 ring-white, shadow-md), a left-aligned name 'Maya Solberg' (15px bold ink) + role 'Head of Product at Orbital' (13px slate-700), and a small brand lockup chip (hidden below sm) = a rounded-lg white box with a slate-200 border holding ph:circles-three-fill + extrabold 'orbital'.
Below the quote card (mt-8), a centered flex (gap-2, 13px, slate-500) reading a teal ph:seal-check-fill icon (16px) followed by 'Verified customer story'.

special_ui_components.prompt: Trust badge pill: a rounded-full teal-soft/50 chip with a teal/20 border holding a ph:shield-check-fill icon and an uppercase wide-tracked teal-deep label 'Trusted in production'

Masked logo wall: a rounded-2xl paper/60 panel whose left/right edges fade via mask-image linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 6%, #000 94%, transparent), holding a 2/3/6-column grid of Phosphor-glyph + wordmark brand lockups that darken slate->ink on hover

Hairline-divided metric trust strip: one white rounded-2xl card split into three cells by divide-y (mobile) / sm:divide-x dividers, with a ring-hair box-shadow, tabular-nums teal numbers, and teal-mid +, /5 and x suffix accents
Hover gradient top-bar: a per-metric-cell absolute top-0 3px from-teal to-teal-mid bar that is opacity-0 and fades to opacity-100 on group hover

Featured quote card: a rounded-3xl white->paper gradient figure with a teal/15 border, a teal->teal-mid->teal 1px top hairline, and a long teal-tinted drop shadow (0 24px 70px -30px rgba(15,118,110,0.35))
Oversized serif quote mark: a 120px Georgia opening-quote glyph in teal/12 absolutely positioned at the card's top-left
Featured-story chip: a rounded-full teal-soft/50 pill holding five ph:star-fill teal stars and an uppercase wide-tracked teal-deep 'Featured story' label
Gradient monogram avatar: a 12x12 rounded-full teal->teal-deep gradient circle with white initials 'MS', a 2px white ring and a soft shadow
Byline brand lockup: a small rounded-lg white box with a slate-200 border holding a ph:circles-three-fill glyph + extrabold 'orbital' wordmark (hidden below sm)
Faint teal grid backdrop: a full-bleed absolute grid of rgba(15,118,110,.05) hairlines on a 44px tile at opacity-60 behind the quote band
Soft teal glow glob: an absolute -left-24 top-1/2 72x72 rounded-full teal-soft/60 blur-3xl blob bleeding off the left edge of the quote band
Verified seal line: a centered teal ph:seal-check-fill icon + 'Verified customer story' caption beneath the quote card

Sticky blurred paper nav: a translucent paper/85 header with backdrop-blur-md and a slate-200/70 bottom hairline, with a teal logo tile and a teal 'Start free' pill whose ph:arrow-right-bold arrow nudges right on hover

Iconify Phosphor icons throughout: ph:sparkle-fill, ph:shield-check-fill, ph:star-fill, ph:seal-check-fill, ph:arrow-right-bold, and the logo-wall glyphs ph:triangle-fill / ph:hexagon-fill / ph:circles-three-fill / ph:cube-fill / ph:lightning-fill / ph:diamond-fill

structured.special_notes: Font: Inter only for all UI text (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800/900), tight tracking, an extrabold/black headline + bold metric numbers; Georgia (serif) is used only for the single oversized decorative quotation mark (.quote-mark). Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme: colors ink #0f172a, slate2 #475569, slate3 #64748b, paper #f8fafc, and a teal object { DEFAULT #0f766e, deep #115e59, soft #ccfbf1, mid #14b8a6 }. Body background is paper #f8fafc with antialiased font smoothing + optimizeLegibility; html has scroll-behavior:smooth. Custom utilities: .tnum (tabular-nums) for the metric numbers; .logowall-fade (horizontal mask 6%->94%) for the logo wall; .ring-hair (box-shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04), 0 0 0 1px rgba(15,23,42,.06)) for the metric card; .quote-mark (Georgia serif) for the big quote glyph; .grain-grid (44px linear-gradient grid in rgba(15,118,110,.05)) behind the quote band. Icons via Iconify (ph:* Phosphor only). The signature moves are the three stacked proof layers (logo wall -> metric strip -> featured quote), the single deep-teal accent on near-white paper, the masked logo wall, the hairline-divided metric strip with hover top-bars and tabular-nums numbers, and the editorial oversized serif quote mark on the gradient quote card. Keep the palette a single teal scale over white/paper, never introduce a second hue.
